name: Copycat Performance
body:
Although marionettes don’t always understand an action, they have a funny habit of copying everything they see with the a performing flair.

Prerequisite(s): Marionette, Perform(any) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): Choose one type of Perform skill that you have 5 ranks in. You gain the benefit of the versatile performance class ability of the bard, allowing you to substitute a Perform check in the place of a check of an associated skill.

The types of Perform and their associated skills are: Act (Bluff, Disguise), Comedy (Bluff, Intimidate), Dance (Acrobatics, Fly), Keyboard Instruments (Diplomacy, Intimidate), Percussion (Handle Animal, Intimidate), and String (Bluff, Diplomacy).
